name: SeoPatchr AI
author: seopatchr

sections.description:
SeoPatchr AI is the companion bridge plugin for the SeoPatchr AI SaaS platform. It seamlessly connects your WordPress site to our cloud crawler to automate your SEO maintenance.

Our external service periodically crawls your website to identify broken links and missing pages (404s). Once identified, the SeoPatchr AI cloud engine generates smart redirect suggestions and context-aware link fixes. After you approve these suggestions in your SeoPatchr AI dashboard, this plugin automatically syncs and applies the changes directly to your WordPress site without requiring any manual editing.

⚠️ Important Notice Regarding Third-Party Service

This plugin relies on the SeoPatchr AI third-party service to function. By using this plugin, your website will communicate with our external servers to fetch redirect rules and report sync statuses.

  • Service URL: https://seopatchr.com
  • Terms of Service & Privacy Policy: Please review our policies at our website before use.

Features

  • Automated Redirect Sync: Periodically fetches approved redirects from your SeoPatchr AI dashboard.
  • Smart Link Fixing: Replaces or unlinks broken links in your posts/pages based on decisions made in the cloud dashboard.
  • Performance Focused: All heavy lifting (crawling, AI analysis) is done on our cloud servers, keeping your WordPress site fast and lean.

External Services

This plugin connects to the SeoPatchr AI service (https://seopatchr.com) to analyze SEO issues and generate fix suggestions.

What data is sent and when:

  • On connecting the plugin: your site URL, WordPress version, and a list of published page URLs/titles are sent to the SeoPatchr AI cloud.
  • Every 15 minutes (via WP-Cron): the plugin fetches your approved redirect and link-fix rules from the cloud and applies them to your site.
  • When a redirect or link fix is applied: the plugin reports back which rules were successfully implemented.

Service details:

  • Service URL: https://seopatchr.com
  • Privacy Policy: https://seopatchr.com/privacy-policy
  • Terms of Service: https://seopatchr.com/terms-conditions

No sensitive personal data (passwords, payment information, etc.) is ever transmitted. All communication uses HTTPS and is authenticated via a private API key unique to your account.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/seopatchr-seo-manager directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Verify the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the SeoPatchr AI settings page in your WordPress admin menu.
  4. Enter your unique API key provided by your SeoPatchr AI dashboard to connect the site.
sections.faq:
Do I need an SeoPatchr AI account?

Yes, this plugin is a connector for the SeoPatchr AI SaaS platform. You will need an active account and API key to use its features.

Does this plugin slow down my site?

No. The plugin only executes lightweight remote fetches periodically. All crawling and AI processing is completely offloaded to our external servers.
